summary: Iteration 67 - Admin Panel testing complete. All 24 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend: All 4 tabs verified working - Roles & Permissions, Team Members, Module Settings, Purchase Orders.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPanel.js is 440 lines - well structured with separate settings components (POSSettings, BookingSettings, etc.)
Good use of data-testid attributes for testing (admin-panel, admin-tab-*, role-*, module-*, etc.)
Built-in roles (admin, manager, receptionist) correctly protected from modification/deletion
Module settings use sensible defaults and persist correctly
seed_data_creation: Test roles created during backend testing (test_role_*, update_test_*, delete_test_*) - cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Panel fully tested. Located in sidebar under SETTINGS section (admin-only). 4 tabs: Roles & Permissions (expandable permission matrix with 14 modules × 6 actions), Team Members (user list with role dropdown), Module Settings (expandable per-module settings for POS, Bookings, Accounting, Messaging, Reviews, Stock, Surveys), Purchase Orders (Generate POs button for low stock items). Built-in roles cannot be modified. Custom roles can be created/updated/deleted. Module settings persist correctly.
